# VayuX Systems (https://vayux.systems)
> Autonomous Cybersecurity R&D Laboratory & Enterprise Incident Assistance

## Overview
VayuX Systems is an innovation-driven cybersecurity research and development firm headquartered in Vadodara, Gujarat, India. VayuX operates an active operational telemetry feedback loop: insights extracted from real-world client defense engagements (SOC, VAPT, DFIR, GRC) are directly channeled into the VayuX R&D Laboratory to build next-generation, self-defending autonomous security architectures.

## Core Operational Pillars & Services

### 1. Security Operations Center (SOC)
- **Description**: 24/7 continuous threat telemetry ingestion, behavioral anomaly detection, and automated threat containment.
- **Specifications**: Sub-15ms event correlation latency, API-driven telemetry ingestion for multi-cloud & on-premise environments, automated C2 severing.
- **URL**: https://vayux.systems/solutions/soc

### 2. Vulnerability Assessment & Penetration Testing (VAPT)
- **Description**: Adversarial simulation and offensive security testing across external attack surfaces, cloud environments, web applications, and mobile apps.
- **Specifications**: OWASP Top 10 eradication, CI/CD automated security hooks, exploit verification without business disruption.
- **URL**: https://vayux.systems/solutions/vapt

### 3. Digital Forensics & Incident Response (DFIR)
- **Description**: 24/7 emergency incident response, ransomware containment, volatile memory analysis, and court-admissible forensic reporting.
- **Specifications**: Sub-4-hour emergency SLA, ISO/IEC 27037 compliance, MITRE ATT&CK TTP mapping, immutable artifact preservation.
- **URL**: https://vayux.systems/solutions/dfir

### 4. Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
- **Description**: Strategic compliance alignment and continuous audit readiness for international and regional cybersecurity frameworks.
- **Specifications**: DPDP Act 2023 readiness, CERT-In directions compliance, ISO 27001 mapping, SOC 2 Type II audit frameworks.
- **URL**: https://vayux.systems/solutions/grc

## Primary Research Domains
- **Autonomous Threat Neutralization**: Heuristic behavioral models designed to identify and isolate zero-day exploit patterns.
- **Post-Quantum Cryptographic Resilience**: Implementing lattice-based and quantum-resistant encryption algorithms for critical infrastructure.
- **Decentralized Zero-Trust Architecture**: Cryptographic consensus-driven verification eliminating single points of enterprise failure.
